# Moodle CLI 0.9.4

A fix for `moodle submit`, which refused every file on assignments that do not restrict file types.

## Fixes

- **`moodle submit` accepts any file type when the assignment sets none.** Moodle renders `"accepted_types":[]` for an assignment with no type restriction. The parser kept that empty list as the allowed set, so every upload stopped with `is not an accepted type; allowed: .` before anything was sent. An empty list now means any type, as it does in the browser.
- **Accepted types that PHP serialised as an object are read as a list.** A PHP array with gaps in its keys arrives as a JSON object; it was being turned into the single type `[object Object]` and sent back to Moodle with the upload.

Checked against a live Moodle 4.5 assignment with `--dry-run`.

## Upgrade

```bash
npm install -g moodle-cli@0.9.4
```

Or:

```bash
moodle update
```

No configuration or cache format changes.
